title: Ukraine ‘losing people and time’, Zelensky says after Oslo talks
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has wrapped up talks with US envoys in Norway Tuesday where he was determined to put diplomacy back on a "more constructive path”, Oslo officials said.
